Measure the contact resistance across the main contacts.

It is necessary to open the break chamber if these tests are negative.

 contact system should be made.

Make sure that no pressure exit in the break 
 chamber.

It is recommended that protective clothing rubber gloves and respirator are 
 used with carrying out this work.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
every ten years as 
indicated by Y10 in the above title block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. Sahar Mohamed Ali, 
accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hussein Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, 
 ... etc.
Isolate and ground both sides of CB.
Switch off and isolate the control circuits i.e. de-energized
Isolate and ground both sides of CB.
Switch off and isolate the control circuits i.e. de-energized
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit,
Cleaning tools.
Safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety harnesses 
 ... etc.
Voltage 
 indicator.
Dew point 
 device, contact resistance device
Work to be Carried Out
Check the high voltage terminal.
Visual check and cleaning of the insulators.
Visual check for control cubical.
Measure the humidity of the SF6 gas "dew point" (commissioning value 
 1.25mg H2O / L at 15◦C ).
Measure the contact resistance across the main contacts.
Current consumption of the operating coil.
Check the sealing of the SF6 gas compartments and the compressed air system.
Important Notes
It is necessary to open the break chamber if these tests are negative.
In the case of doubt one chamber should be opened a visual check of the 
 contact system should be made.
Before Opening
Make sure that no pressure exit in the break 
 chamber.
The SF6 gas should be removed using the service wagon.
It is recommended that protective clothing rubber gloves and respirator are 
 used with carrying out this work.
